summary_paragraph: A male patient with a history of recurrent venous thromboembolism, IVC filter placement, chronic pain, and non-adherence to anticoagulation presented with pleuritic chest pain, LLQ abdominal pain, and mild diarrhea after running out of Lovenox five days prior. Imaging revealed a new non-occlusive thrombus at the IVC filter site, which had shifted but not penetrated the vessel wall. No pulmonary embolism or acute cardiac issue was found. The chest pain was determined to be musculoskeletal, and diarrhea was likely viral. He was restarted on Lovenox, managed for pain and anxiety, and discharged home with a short course of oxycodone, clear instructions on anticoagulation adherence, and follow-up plans with his PCP and pain clinic.
